# unifi_setting_radio_ai (Resource)

The `unifi_setting_radio_ai` resource manages AI-driven radio optimization ("AI WiFi") for a UniFi site. When enabled, the controller periodically analyzes the RF environment and adjusts channel, channel width, and transmit power on managed access points. This resource controls the scope of that optimization (which radios and channels are eligible), the schedule (`cron_expr`), and per-device or per-radio overrides.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "unifi_setting_radio_ai" "example" {
  # Enable AI-driven radio optimization ("AI WiFi").
  enabled = true

  # Manage the parameters explicitly rather than leaving everything on auto.
  # Valid options: "auto", "manual"
  setting_preference = "manual"

  # Let the optimizer adjust both channel and transmit power.
  optimize = ["channel", "power"]

  # Optimize the 5 GHz and 2.4 GHz radios.
  radios = ["na", "ng"]

  # Run the optimization nightly at 03:00.
  cron_expr = "0 3 * * *"

  # Constrain eligible channels to the country's regulatory domain.
  auto_adjust_channels_to_country = true

  # Restrict the 5 GHz radio to a known-good channel set and widths.
  channels_na = [36, 40, 44, 48, 149, 153, 157, 161]
  ht_modes_na = [20, 40, 80]

  # Never let the optimizer pick this channel/width on 5 GHz.
  channels_blacklist {
    channel       = 144
    channel_width = 160
    radio         = "na"
  }

  # Per-radio tuning: allow 80 MHz on 5 GHz but keep DFS channels off.
  radios_configuration {
    radio         = "na"
    channel_width = 80
    dfs           = false
  }

  # Keep a critical AP out of the optimization entirely.
  # exclude_devices = ["aa:bb:cc:dd:ee:ff"]

  # Specify the site (optional, defaults to site configured in provider, otherwise "default")
  # site = "default"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `auto_adjust_channels_to_country` (Boolean) Whether the eligible channel set is automatically constrained to those permitted by the site's country/regulatory domain.
- `auto_channel_presets_type` (String) Optimization preset governing how aggressively channels are chosen. One of `maximum_speed`, `conservative`, or `custom`.
- `channels_6e` (List of Number) Eligible channels for the 6 GHz (6E) radio during optimization.
- `channels_blacklist` (Attributes List) Channel/width/radio combinations the optimizer must never select. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--channels_blacklist))
- `channels_na` (List of Number) Eligible channels for the 5 GHz (na) radio during optimization.
- `channels_ng` (List of Number) Eligible channels for the 2.4 GHz (ng) radio during optimization.
- `cron_expr` (String) Cron expression defining when the optimization runs (e.g. `0 3 * * *` for 03:00 daily).
- `default` (Boolean) Whether this configuration is the controller's default AI optimization profile.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether AI radio optimization is enabled for the site.
- `exclude_devices` (List of String) MAC addresses of access points excluded from AI optimization.
- `high_priority_devices` (List of String) MAC addresses of access points the optimizer should prioritize.
- `ht_modes_na` (List of Number) Eligible channel widths (MHz) for the 5 GHz (na) radio, e.g. `20`, `40`, `80`, `160`.
- `ht_modes_ng` (List of Number) Eligible channel widths (MHz) for the 2.4 GHz (ng) radio, e.g. `20`, `40`.
- `optimize` (List of String) Which radio properties the optimizer may adjust. Values: `channel`, `power`.
- `radios` (List of String) Which radio bands participate in optimization. Values: `na` (5 GHz), `ng` (2.4 GHz), `6e` (6 GHz).
- `radios_configuration` (Attributes List) Per-radio optimization parameters such as allowed channel width and DFS usage. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--radios_configuration))
- `setting_preference` (String) Whether the settings are managed automatically by the controller (`auto`) or overridden manually (`manual`).
- `site` (String) The name of the UniFi site where this resource should be applied. If not specified, the default site will be used.
- `use_xy` (Boolean) Whether the newer (XY) optimization engine is used.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The unique identifier of this resource.

<a id="nestedatt--channels_blacklist"></a>
### Nested Schema for `channels_blacklist`

Optional:

- `channel` (Number) Channel number to exclude.
- `channel_width` (Number) Channel width (MHz) the exclusion applies to.
- `radio` (String) Radio band the exclusion applies to. One of `na`, `ng`, `6e`.


<a id="nestedatt--radios_configuration"></a>
### Nested Schema for `radios_configuration`

Optional:

- `channel_width` (Number) Channel width (MHz) the optimizer may use for this radio.
- `dfs` (Boolean) Whether DFS (radar-shared) channels may be selected for this radio.
- `radio` (String) Radio band this configuration applies to. One of `na`, `ng`, `6e`.
